# Library app: stories

## Members

As a member, I want to search the catalogue by title, author or ISBN so that I can find a book
quickly.
- Results appear as I type.
- A search with no match says so and offers to suggest an acquisition.

As a member, I want to reserve a book that is out so that I get it when it comes back.
- I am told by email when it is ready.
- A reservation lapses after 3 days if I do not collect the book.

As a member, I want to see my loans and due dates in one place so that I never pay a late fee by
accident.

## Librarians

As a librarian, I want to scan a book's barcode to check it out to a member so that the desk queue
stays short.
- A member with unpaid fees over 10 euros cannot borrow until they pay.

As a librarian, I want to export a monthly loans report as CSV so that I can send it to the council.

## Quality bar

- The catalogue search returns in under 1 second for a catalogue of 500,000 titles.
- Member data is stored in the EU and never leaves it.
- The app has to work on the desk computers, which run an old browser: the latest version of Edge
  from two years ago.

## Later, maybe

As a member, I want recommendations so that I discover new books. Not planned.
